name: InboxHiive
oneliner: Podcast episodes, turned into newsletters you can read in minutes.
summary: InboxHiive turns podcast episodes into clean, readable newsletters. Subscribe to the shows you follow and get an AI-written summary, key insights, and a chapter-by-chapter breakdown of each new episode in your inbox.
description: Podcast backlogs pile up. InboxHiive lets you keep up without listening to every minute. Pick the shows you follow, and each new episode arrives as a short newsletter.
Every issue has episode highlights, the key insights as a scannable list, and a chapter breakdown with timestamps so you can jump to the part worth hearing.

Behind it is an event-driven pipeline on Firebase: a new episode kicks off audio processing and parallel, schema-validated summaries with Gemini, then delivery. Akhil wrote up how it works in Building InboxHiive.

faq.a: InboxHiive is a web app by Modrn Magic that turns podcast episodes into email newsletters with AI summaries, key insights, and chapter breakdowns.
A new episode triggers a pipeline on Firebase Functions and Firestore that processes the audio, generates structured summaries with Gemini, and sends the newsletter.
